name: Times club monthly special crossword No 20,243

solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Conserve and start to grow short evergreen tree

indicators.note: something cut short has lost its tail, so the final letter of the preceding phrase goes

blocks.note: a conserve is a fruit preserve
to bud is to begin growing, as a shoot does

explanation.surface: A gardener makes preserves and begins growing a small evergreen tree.
explanation.definitionFit: The jambu is a tropical Asian evergreen tree of the myrtle family, grown for its rose-apple fruit.

clue.text: Suitor embracing daughter’s after wee supper alone in Perth

indicators.note: to embrace is to hold in the arms, so the suitor wraps around the daughter's letters
after places the suitor part behind the word for wee in the finished answer

blocks.note: rhyming slang: Jimmy Riddle means piddle, so jimmy is a wee
a wooer courts someone
D for daughter, plus the S of the possessive

explanation.surface: A Scottish suitor's daughter has a small late meal by herself in Perth.
explanation.walkthrough: Wee and Perth suggest Scotland, but Perth is the Western Australian city, and a supper here is someone who sups, a drinker.
explanation.definitionFit: Australian slang for a man drinking solo at the bar, or for the drink taken that way.

clue.text: How one works on garment for Lassie?

blocks.note: MO is modus operandi, a person's method of working
a rag is informal for an item of clothing

explanation.surface: A question about how a person goes about sewing clothes for the famous film collie.
explanation.walkthrough: Lassie looks like the dog, but it is a Scots girl; the question mark marks this name as one example of a lassie.
explanation.definitionFit: Morag is a common Scottish girl's first name, so one bearer exemplifies a young Scots woman.

clue.text: Winter festival organised à la Yule around hostelry

indicators.note: things organised are put into a fresh order, so the French-flavoured phrase is rearranged
around means the rearranged letters surround the word for a pub

blocks.note: taken as written, accent dropped
PH is the abbreviation for public house

explanation.surface: A winter celebration arranged in Christmas fashion around the local inn.
explanation.definitionFit: Up Helly Aa is the Shetland fire festival held each January, ending with the burning of a Viking galley.

clue.text: A siciliana could include this, con potenza (ma non forte)

indicators.note: Italian for but not, so the following item is taken away from the Italian word for power

blocks.note: a con is a swindle
potenza and forza are both Italian for power or force
f is the musical marking for forte, loud

explanation.surface: Reads like a musical score: a Sicilian dance piece played with power, but not loudly.
explanation.walkthrough: A siciliana is both a Sicilian dance tune, as the surface suggests, and a Sicilian-style pizza.
explanation.definitionFit: Scamorza is a southern Italian stretched-curd cheese, a typical topping on a Sicilian pizza.

clue.text: Points in Ascension Island necessary for southern islanders

indicators.note: ascension is rising, and in a down entry letters that rise are read from bottom to top

blocks.note: I is the abbreviation for island
tines are the prongs or points of a fork or antler

explanation.surface: A note on the essentials and sharp landmarks of a South Atlantic island.
explanation.walkthrough: Ascension Island is a real place, but here Ascension signals the reversal; the necessary is slang for money.
explanation.definitionFit: The seniti is the hundredth part of the Tongan pa'anga, cash used by Pacific islanders south of the equator.

clue.text: Groups influenced by media hoarded after promotion of last shop’s opening

indicators.note: promotion moves something up, so the final letter climbs towards the top of this down entry
an opening is the start, so only the initial letter of shop is kept
after puts the shop letter behind the reworked word

blocks.note: to hoard is to amass
first letter of shop

explanation.surface: Crowds swayed by advertising stockpiled goods once a shop opened.
explanation.walkthrough: In AMASSED the final D rises to sit just after the A, giving ADMASSE, before S joins.
explanation.definitionFit: Admass is the mass public targeted and swayed by advertising and commercial media, so its plural is such populations.

clue.text: Topsy-turvy Home Office drama continued

indicators.note: topsy-turvy means upside down, so this down entry's letters are read from the bottom

blocks.note: a den is a room in the home used as a study
No, also spelt Noh, is classical Japanese drama

explanation.surface: A chaotic government department's saga ran on and on.
explanation.walkthrough: Home Office looks like the UK ministry; here it is a single study room.
explanation.definitionFit: To on is a dialect verb meaning to go on or proceed, so onned means went on.

clue.text: Take a new tack to stop decline in zirconium and silver coin

indicators.note: to stop a gap is to plug it, so the tack-changing word goes inside the word for decline
in places the combined decline word inside the chemical symbol

blocks.note: Zr is the chemical symbol for zirconium
to wane is to decline
to zig is to change direction sharply

explanation.surface: Advice to change course to halt a slump in metal prices.
explanation.walkthrough: Silver tempts the solver toward the chemical symbol for that metal, but here it belongs to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The Zwanziger was an old Austrian silver coin worth twenty kreuzer, hence the name meaning twentier.

clue.text: Opium fiend’s letter in early hours with Arab account

indicators.note: in puts the Greek letter inside the word for early hours

blocks.note: morn is the morning
phi is a Greek letter
an Omani is an Arab from Oman
AC is the abbreviation for account

explanation.surface: A drug addict writes a letter before dawn, with a story from an Arab.
explanation.definitionFit: A morphinomaniac is an addict of morphine, the chief narcotic derived from opium.

clue.text: Kind and polite male descendant entertaining current Scotsman

indicators.note: to entertain a guest is to take them in, so the descendant holds the current symbol

blocks.note: a grandson is a male descendant
I is the symbol for electric current
Ian is a typical Scottish man's name

explanation.surface: A courteous grandson plays host to a Scot just arrived.
explanation.definitionFit: Grandisonian describes chivalrous courtesy like that of Sir Charles Grandison, Richardson's ideal gentleman hero.

clue.text: It may make one fit regressive group, not in Jewish style?

indicators.note: regressive means going backwards, so the whole wordplay string is read from right to left

blocks.note: a set is a group
à la means in the style of, and a goy is a non-Jew

explanation.surface: Asks whether a backward-looking gentile group fits in.
explanation.walkthrough: Fit looks like belonging; it means physically fit. Goy is Yiddish for a non-Jew.
explanation.definitionFit: Yogalates is an exercise system blending yoga and Pilates, a routine people follow to get in shape.

clue.text: Duke from Transcaucasia, mostly a shocking one?

indicators.note: mostly means not quite all, so the person from the region loses the final letter

blocks.note: D is the abbreviation for duke
an Azeri comes from Azerbaijan, in Transcaucasia

explanation.surface: A nobleman from the Caucasus is largely a scandalous figure.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that dazes stuns or stupefies, as an electric shock or a startling event does.

clue.text: Joburg city has oddly banished African rhino

indicators.note: banishing the odd-numbered characters leaves only the even ones of the phrase

blocks.note: second, fourth, sixth letters and so on

explanation.surface: Johannesburg has driven out a strange African rhinoceros.
explanation.walkthrough: Rhino looks like the animal, but it is old British slang for money.
explanation.definitionFit: The ouguiya is the currency of Mauritania in West Africa, and rhino is slang for cash.

clue.text: Gum doctor now on top of gingiva: this keeps another band in place

definitions.text: this keeps another band in place

indicators.note: the top of a word in a down entry is its first letter

blocks.note: guar gum is a thickener from the guar bean
Dr is the abbreviation for doctor
in means fashionable or current
first letter of gingiva

explanation.surface: A dentist working on the gums now examines the surface of the gingiva.
explanation.walkthrough: Gum and gingiva set a dental scene; gingiva is the medical word for the gum.
explanation.definitionFit: A guard ring, or keeper ring, is worn on the finger beside a looser ring, such as a wedding ring, to stop it slipping off.

clue.text: Note a sporting partner aboard Boston trolley for service?

blocks.note: te is a note of the sol-fa scale
taken as written
WAGs are the wives and girlfriends of sportsmen, a British tabloid term
on board means on

explanation.surface: A sports star's partner rides a trolley around Boston.
explanation.walkthrough: Boston marks the definition as American usage.
explanation.definitionFit: Tea wagon is the American name for a tea trolley, a wheeled stand for serving refreshments.

clue.text: What person, objectively flash, is causing disorder in the country?

blocks.note: whom is the object form of who
bling is flashy jewellery

explanation.surface: Asks which showy person is stirring up trouble across the nation.
explanation.walkthrough: In the country means in rural dialect, not within a nation.
explanation.definitionFit: Whomble is a dialect verb meaning to overturn or upset, a variant of whemmle, so whombling is upsetting things.

clue.text: As soon as inside court, against brilliant turn of phrase

indicators.note: inside places the time phrase within the abbreviation for court

blocks.note: CT is the abbreviation for court
once means as soon as, in once he arrives
to can mean against, as in shoulder to shoulder

explanation.surface: Once in the courtroom, counsel argues against a dazzling bit of rhetoric.
explanation.definitionFit: A concetto is an ingenious conceit, a witty or elaborate figure of speech, from Italian.

clue.text: Stop benefit withdrawn by two male relatives

indicators.note: withdrawn means pulled back, so the word for benefit is written backwards

blocks.note: aid is help or benefit
PA, a father, and SON

explanation.surface: A father and son have their welfare payments cut off.
explanation.walkthrough: Stop looks like a verb, but it is an organ stop.
explanation.definitionFit: A diapason is one of the principal stops of a pipe organ, giving its characteristic tone.

clue.text: Some carp about editorial my young men set in stone?

indicators.note: about means going around, so the fish surrounds the editorial word

blocks.note: koi are a kind of ornamental carp
editors write we and our where others say I and my

explanation.surface: Some people complain about an editorial written by unyielding youths.
explanation.walkthrough: Carp suggests grumbling, but it is the fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Kouroi are archaic Greek statues of naked youths, literally young men carved from marble.

clue.text: Arabic city runs out of old money from Helsinki Hotel

indicators.note: runs out of means the money is left without the letter for runs

blocks.note: the markka was Finland's currency before the euro
Hotel is H in the phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: An Arab town's cash flows out of a Helsinki hotel.
explanation.walkthrough: R stands for runs, the cricket scoring abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Makkah is the Arabic transliteration of Mecca, the holy city in Saudi Arabia.

clue.text: See returns, by being hedged, briefly ineligible for bonus

indicators.note: returns means comes back, so the Latin word for see is written backwards
something hedged is fenced in, so the letter for by sits enclosed

blocks.note: vide is Latin for see, used in cross-references
x means by, as in a three by four room

explanation.surface: A trader's hedged returns are cut off from any bonus.
explanation.walkthrough: Returns and hedged look like finance; here they are signals.
explanation.definitionFit: Ex div, short for ex dividend, describes shares sold without the right to the next dividend payout.

clue.text: Indian ambassador related losing base in variant reading

indicators.note: the base of a down entry is its bottom letter, which is dropped
in places the shortened word inside the abbreviation for variant reading

blocks.note: vl is varia lectio, Latin for variant reading
akin means related

explanation.surface: An Indian envoy's kinsman has a different take on a text.
explanation.definitionFit: A vakil is an Indian agent or representative, historically an envoy or ambassador, and now an attorney.

clue.text: Scottish shellfish company hosts testing site, near complete

indicators.note: a host holds guests within, so the company abbreviation wraps the rest

blocks.note: CO is the abbreviation for company
a lab is where tests are run
by means near, as in close by
to do a job is to complete it

explanation.surface: A Scottish seafood firm runs a test facility that is almost finished.
explanation.definitionFit: Clabby-doo is a Scots word for a large horse mussel, an edible shellfish.

clue.text: Pet needs area for centre of attack

indicators.note: for means in place of, so the middle letter of the attack word is swapped out

blocks.note: A is the abbreviation for area
to decry is to attack verbally

explanation.surface: A sports pundit says the favourite needs space in the middle of the forward line.
explanation.walkthrough: DECRY has C at its centre; A replaces it.
explanation.definitionFit: Deary is an affectionate form of address, like darling or love, as pet is too.

clue.text: Short story from Volume One that follows artist keeping duplicate of empty ink case

indicators.note: an empty word has lost its insides, leaving only its first and last letters
keeping means holding within, so the artist abbreviation surrounds the doubled material
the volume and one come after the rest of the answer

blocks.note: RA is a Royal Academician
outer letters of ink
a kit is a case or set of equipment
a second copy of the letters from the empty ink and the case
V is the abbreviation for volume
Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A tale from the first volume about an artist holding a copy of a dry pen case.
explanation.walkthrough: Duplicate is not an indicator for a shuffle: it simply means the same letters appear twice in a row.
explanation.definitionFit: Rikki-Tikki-Tavi is Kipling's tale of a brave mongoose, collected in The Jungle Book.

clue.text: French food standard broken by plant’s abnormal growth with hard wood

indicators.note: a thing broken by another is split open with the other placed inside the gap

blocks.note: AOC, appellation d'origine contrôlée, is the French quality label for foods and wines
a gall is an abnormal swelling on a plant
H is the pencil-grade abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: A French food standard is wrecked by a diseased plant with tough timber.
explanation.walkthrough: Hard wood looks like one phrase, hardwood; hard is wordplay and wood alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Agalloch is the fragrant resinous heartwood of an Asian tree, also called eaglewood or aloeswood.

clue.text: Holyrood’s somewhat revolutionary blackballer as an illustration

indicators.note: revolutionary means turning round, so the combined words are written backwards

blocks.note: one who blackballs votes no, nay
e.g. means for example

explanation.surface: A Scottish parliamentarian casts a fairly radical vote against, by way of example.
explanation.walkthrough: Holyrood is the seat of the Scottish Parliament, marking a Scots word.
explanation.definitionFit: Geyan is Scots for rather or fairly, a variant of gey, an intensifying adverb.
